minimum_space_model.principle: keep parts and kits off the 55 m final track until they are accepted subassemblies

planning_basis: one first-article three-car LM3 trainset after design release/material availability; one long final assembly track; off-line steel, composite, bogie, and interior benches run in parallel
release_status: rough-order planning; not a shop-approved baseline

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Freeze the build sequence once so steel, composite, bogie, HV, and interior cells can start together.
tasks.space_requirement: planning desk plus controlled document store
tasks.title: release traveler pack, work orders, QA gates, and material lots

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Batch all three car kits; do not occupy car-length fixtures until parts are deburred, marked, and inspected.
tasks.space_requirement: one saw/laser/plasma area, one press brake, pallet lanes for three car kits
tasks.title: cut, form, drill, and kit structural steel chassis/body parts

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Two fixtures keep the third underframe from extending the train-level path while avoiding three full weld bays.
tasks.space_requirement: two 18 m rotating underframe fixtures plus local bolster/coupler subfixtures
tasks.title: weld three underframe datum weldments

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Run side-frame and floor close-up as a rolling wave from released underframes.
tasks.space_requirement: two side/roof frame fixtures and one transfer stand
tasks.title: add side/roof spaceframes, floors, portals, roof rails, and chassis interfaces

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Bogie work is fully parallel to carbody welding; final track waits only for released bogies.
tasks.space_requirement: three bogie stands, one wheelset lane, and one brake/sensor bench
tasks.title: assemble powered/trailer bogies, wheelsets, suspension, brake, and bogie harness kits

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Short moulds and CNC trim keep the composite work off the final train bay.
tasks.space_requirement: four short module moulds, one trim table, one master-frame dry-fit stand
tasks.title: mould, cure, demould, trim, drill, and kit 144 GFRP exterior modules

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Pre-kit seats, grab rails, floor finish, ceiling/sidewall liners, PIS, CCTV, lighting, and labels by car/door zone.
tasks.space_requirement: trim bench, seat/grab-rail rack, electrical label bench, quarantine shelves
tasks.title: prebuild internal furnishings and cabin trim kits

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Paint only dimensionally accepted steel frames; clip rails and drain lands are masked and gauged before release.
tasks.space_requirement: one car-length paint bay plus flash-off/inspection lane
tasks.title: blast, prime, topcoat, cavity-wax, and release painted carbody frames

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Use the one-shift six-crew route; no production adhesive cure blocks the path.
tasks.space_requirement: three parallel car positions for one shift
tasks.title: install clip-on GFRP side/roof modules and complete water/rattle pre-test

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Door/window/HVAC crews work car-by-car while electrical rough-in starts in released zones.
tasks.space_requirement: one 55 m final track, two mobile roof platforms, glazing stands
tasks.title: install doors, windows, roof HVAC/PV hardware, and exterior service details
tasks.work_center: final assembly track with glazing/roof access

tasks.parallelisation_notes: HV/LV/coolant crews work in parallel with roof and door installation but release independently.
tasks.space_requirement: same 55 m final track with lockout boundary and two under-seat service carts
tasks.title: install HV battery, traction, LV/control, safety loops, coolant, and fire interfaces

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Use pre-kitted interiors; keep floor/seat/liner installation behind tested doors/windows to avoid rework from leaks.
tasks.space_requirement: same 55 m final track, three car interiors worked as zones
tasks.title: install internal furnishings, flooring, liners, seats, grab rails, PIS, CCTV, lighting, and signage

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Released bogies enter late; this keeps wheelset/brake work out of the carbody assembly bay.
tasks.space_requirement: same 55 m final track with jacks or shallow pit and bogie drop/lift equipment
tasks.title: marry bogies to carbodies and close brake/ride-height static checks

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Close car-to-car mechanical interfaces after interiors and bogie marriage are stable.
tasks.space_requirement: same 55 m final track plus end-cowl access stands
tasks.title: install articulation, gangways, end cowls, couplers, sensor packs, and trainlines

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Static testing is the first convergence of HV, brakes, doors, HVAC, onboard controls, and passenger systems.
tasks.space_requirement: same 55 m final track with shore power and station-charge simulator
tasks.title: static commissioning, insulation, door/HVAC/brake tests, snag closeout, and QA release

tasks.parallelisation_notes: Do not move unresolved static defects onto the test track; protect dynamic-test access as the last bottleneck.
tasks.space_requirement: short test track, charging interface, fault desk
tasks.title: dynamic commissioning and trial-running release
